build_InceptionV3_backbone: build an InceptionV3 backbone model with 100 classes using mmpretrain registry
build_InceptionV3_with_aux_logits: build an InceptionV3 backbone with auxiliary classification branch enabled for training
create_BasicConv2d_block: create a BasicConv2d block with convolution, batch normalization, and ReLU activation
